_note: SYNTHETIC example calls for testing the Call Guardian. Not real calls. Each line is one transcribed utterance; speakers are mixed, as on a real merged call.

lines: السلام عليكم معك أحمد من قسم الحماية في البنك
حسابك موقوف بسبب عملية مشبوهة ولازم نفعّله فوراً
راح يوصلك الحين رمز التحقق على جوالك، اقرأ لي الرمز
ولا تخبر أحد لأن هذا إجراء سري
Hello, this is officer Khalid from Abu Dhabi police
There is an arrest warrant in your name for an unpaid fine
You must pay the fine immediately to avoid a travel ban
Install AnyDesk so I can help you pay, and do not hang up
Hi, I'm calling from Emirates Post about your parcel
Your parcel is held at customs, please open the link we sent by SMS
تمام الحمد لله، بتجي العشا الليلة؟
Good afternoon, this is a reminder from your bank that your credit card payment is due on the fifth
You can pay in the app as usual. We will never ask you for a code or your PIN on a call
Thank you, have a good day
